name: dspark-adapt-mult-n8k-r0
purpose: Original conditional T5 follow-up: repeat the best EAGLE setting (adapt-mult-n8k-r0) on the DSpark e10 head. One arm only; no search over settings.

initializer.rebinding: Copy config.json with speculators_config.verifier.name_or_path set to the contract's authorized_checkpoint (the original points at an inaccessible private snapshot of the same revision); weights and other files are symlinks to the original.

data.format: Trace rows become speculators rows {id, input_ids = prompt_ids + generated_ids, loss_mask = 0 on the prompt, 1 on the completion (EOS included)}, the layout of Yu's DSpark corpus; nothing is re-tokenized. Target hidden states come from the trainer's per-rank extraction servers (--on-missing generate), as in e10's training, so no stored features are regenerated.
data.split: speculators holds out the trailing rows by position: train file = 8,000 trace rows then the 256 dev rows, train_data_ratio 0.969 (int(8256*0.969) = 8000); OPB file = the first 256 dev rows as a placeholder train part then the first 512 OPB held-out rows, ratio 0.3334 (int(768*0.3334) = 256).

training.total_seq_len_basis: 16 rows per rank at the 584-token mean length of the 8,000 traces, so a step holds about 32 rows (EAGLE: 32 rows per step, 12,288 rows = 1.54 epochs in 384 steps).
training.learning_rate_basis: Same value as the EAGLE setting, for both the Muon (2D, match_rms_adamw) and AdamW groups.
training.schedule: cosine with 0 cycles = constant after 19 linear warmup steps (EAGLE: constant after 19 warmup steps)
training.unchanged_from_e10_recipe: speculator dspark, block 8, markov rank 256, confidence head with markov, loss {ce 0.1, tv 0.9}, eager loss, optimizer muon (weight decay 0.1 Muon / 0 AdamW defaults), max anchors 1024, target layers 1/8/15/22/29, full verifier vocabulary

evaluation.method: speculators validation epoch on the held-out part of a prepared dataset, after one optimizer step at learning rate 0 (weights checked bitwise unchanged against the evaluated checkpoint). Same total_seq_len, seed and trainer for initial and final.
evaluation.development_metric: eal_epoch on the 256 multilingual dev traces
evaluation.forgetting_metric: eal_epoch on the first 512 OPB held-out rows

gates.finite_losses: every logged training loss and both final validation losses finite
gates.real_updates: exported weights differ from e10 in at least one tensor
gates.export: exported tensors bitwise equal to the trained checkpoint, same names/shapes/dtypes as e10, config equal to e10 apart from the verifier path
gates.evaluation_unchanged: every lr-0 evaluation leaves its weights bitwise unchanged

selection: Unchanged EAGLE rule: all gates and dev eal gain >= +0.20 (absolute); otherwise negative_complete without serving.
confirmation: Unchanged EAGLE design (adapt-recovery-policy.json confirmation block, job 3814370's ten workloads and corpus hashes): base = DSpark e10, adapted = exported head, k3/k7 x C1/64/256, two GPU-swapped rounds in one normal allocation, Apertus sampling, calibrated greedy gate on the first 32 prompts.
verdict: Unchanged EAGLE recommendation rule (>=10% throughput and >=10% median TPOT in both repeats; TTFT/tail/OPB regressions make it a conditional tradeoff).
